buildCheck.reason: This change only extends the integration probe; production sources and the previously verified main-process build are unchanged.

selectionCancellation.trigger: The test monitor resolves the production selection cutoff as selection_cancelled after the real utilityProcess has sent a decoded response.
selectionCancellation.responseGate: The probe temporarily gates the real UtilityImageWorker message handler, leaving its decode request pending until the production cancellation signal aborts it.

preparationDeadline.trigger: The VM copy of IMAGE_LIMITS shortens the selection preparation deadline to 8000 ms; the fake selection monitor remains pending while a decoded response from the cold-started real utilityProcess is gated.

real: production copySelectedItem orchestration extracted from src/main/main.ts
production ImagePreparationService and its absolute deadline/abort handling
real Electron utilityProcess decoder response and child-process exit after cancellation/timeout
fake: selection key-release monitor and cutoff decision

limitations: The test intercepts a response after the utilityProcess has completed decoding and emitted the message, but before UtilityImageWorker handles it. It verifies that a real pending request is aborted and its child is terminated; it does not prove cancellation interrupts decoder CPU work in progress.

The timeout integration uses an 8000 ms VM-only deadline to allow cold utilityProcess startup after cancellation retires the prior process. It exercises the production ImagePreparationService deadline path with the resulting absolute deadline, not a real 3000 ms deadline under clipboard load.

The key-release monitor, helper, clipboard, panel, and input boundaries are fakes. No real key timing, BrowserWindow behavior, helper cancellation after registration, OS clipboard, panel side effect, physical input, or target-visible paste was tested.
P15 repeated Base64 decoding/hashing in src/main/native/content-provider.ts remains outside the user-approved T04 scope and remains open.
